dialogue.speaker: Dolores Marrow
dialogue.text: You know what I like about you? You never pretend. That's rare down here. Everyone's busy auditioning for heaven.

dialogue.speaker: Dolores Marrow
dialogue.text: I'll tell you a secret: I don't want out. I want a decent bar and someone to argue with. You qualify.

dialogue.speaker: Dolores Marrow
dialogue.text: Don't let it go to your head. The tab's still due.
